verdict_summary: Round 3 paradigm pivot from weight-modification (6 prior trials all MONITORING_ONLY) to pure scalar gross-exposure overlay. Three β_t mappings tested on STR_1715 PG2 actual walk-forward returns via Q-Lead post-hoc baseline correction (Forge v1 used static May-2026 snapshot held constant 268m, mis-reproducing L-274 by ~24pp/0.87 SR). Mathematical equivalence of post-hoc scalar β·r_PG2 to stock-level β·w_PG2 holds by closed-form identity. **S1 threshold_step delivers first triad result**: Sharpe IMPROVEMENT (+0.0572, 1.7758 vs S0 1.7186) + MDD reduction (-12.16pp, -29.53% vs S0 -41.69%) + alpha rank correlation == 1.0 strict (mathematical proof + 268/268 runtime audit, 0 violations). However, **full PASS verdict is blocked** by three binding gaps: (1) AX-008 1.5/3 below 2.0 floor (Forge v2 PASS + Codex Round 1 REJECT-then-PARTIAL + Architect NOT_INVOKED); (2) Harvey 5-spec (CAPM/FF3/Carhart4/FF5/FF6) absent — multi-test penalty across 54 candidate space (9 K,W cells × 3 mappings × 2 MP filters) inadequately addressed by 14×0.05 SR haircut (not a true DSR per Bailey-Lopez de Prado 2014); (3) Total turnover S1 = 750%/yr (STR_1715 PG2 base) + 9.34%/yr (overlay |Δβ| × 12) = 759.3%/yr exceeds 600%/yr hurdle hard cap. S2 linear is MONITORING_ONLY (Sharpe degraded -0.19, 22% full-cash months over-aggressive). S3 sigmoid is MONITORING_PLUS_TAIL_OPTIMIZED (MDD -19.74% PASS absolute -25%, vol -48% PASS, Sortino 0.98 marginal). Cross-WT: WT-007 differentiator is the Sharpe-improvement+MDD-reduction+alpha-preservation triad in S1 — none of WT-001 PCA / WT-002 DCC / WT-003 HMM / WT-004 RMT / WT-005 Factor Beta / WT-006 IPCA achieved Sharpe IMPROVEMENT under preservation mandate. Recommendation: register S1+S3 as MONITORING_PLUS research artifacts (do NOT promote to production sizing this WT — recommendation_only mandate). Promotion to production sizing requires future WT with: (a) Architect 3rd-source independent Forge re-run; (b) full Harvey 5-spec + proper DSR; (c) lockbox-only sub-decomposition (2024-07~2026-05); (d) total-turnover compliance plan or hurdle waiver.

cross_wt_compare.structural_insight: The 6 prior trials all attempted weight-vector transformations of STR_1715 alpha; each created TO churn or alpha decay that overwhelmed risk-management gains. Round 3 pivot: factor scalar β·w preserves the alpha completely (mathematical) and only adjusts gross. The Sharpe-improvement result (rare in pure-overlay paradigm) is mechanistically explained by: AR threshold de-risks during systemic concentration spikes (eigenvalue-1 dominance >q90); STR_1715 PG2 has 41% raw MDD with body returns retained otherwise; threshold-step (β_floor=0.4 in q90+) avoids worst tail without sacrificing body.
